name: INCLUDE
citation: Sridhar, Ganesan, Kumar, Khapra. INCLUDE: A Large Scale Dataset for Indian Sign Language Recognition. ACM MM 2020.
task: isolated word-level Indian Sign Language recognition (one sign per video, not sentences)

recording.place: St. Louis School for the Deaf, Adyar, Chennai
recording.signers: deaf students; typically cited as 7 signers
recording.note: Chennai ISL. ISL varies across India, so a different region's signs will not match.

on_disk_layout.match_rule: match splits by suffix Category/N. Word/filename, ignore the _1of2 zip-part prefix
on_disk_layout.extra_subfolder_trap: some clips live in .../N. Word/Extra/clip.MOV — parent folder is Extra, not the word. Label must use the Word folder, not Extra.

why_live_predictions_fail: Current model only knows 84 of 263 words. Signing Dog, Teacher, Water, etc. cannot be correct.
INCLUDE is isolated one-sign clips from Chennai school students on a fixed camera. Webcam + different signer + different lighting is a different distribution.
The classifier averages all frames (mean/std/min/max). Signs are motion, so similar greetings/family signs collide.
The 98.7% train_report number is leakage (augment then split), not real accuracy.
